fields.NAME: Funnel: club invoices nobody paid
fields.NOTE: No safe probe has been sent: the 2026-09-09 probe pass predates this registration, which is why the manifest row carries no deployment reading. The live status endpoint answered on 2026-09-22 with 11 runs over seven days and none failed. SIDE_EFFECTS drops the manifest's db-read, which the catalog vocabulary cannot say; the run reads the invoices it marks. Abandonment is a conclusion, not a report: Telegram tells nobody when a person closes a payment window, so the rule is an invoice older than an hour with no charge after it, and it lives in services/trackEvent.ts where it is tested apart from the schedule. A unique index makes the row land once however often the job runs, and an unreadable table throws so that could not look reaches the failure handler instead of printing as nobody walked away.
fields.SUMMARY_EN: Every hour marks the club invoices that are older than an hour with no charge after them as abandoned, writing one funnel row per invoice so that the path from card to invoice to paid or abandoned can be read without joining tables by hand. It charges nothing and messages nobody.

fields.NAME: CRM: proactive seller sweep
fields.NOTE: Born 2026-09-12 when the proactive sweep left an in-process setInterval (CRM_SWEEP_DRIVER=timer restores it, CRM_PROACTIVE_MINUTES=0 disables both). Concurrency 1 and retries 0 because a tick may push a card to a seller; a retry or an overlap could push a second one. Safe mode (e2e_test=true) skips the run entirely; no carrier registered returns did=paused, not an error. 2026-09-17: three FAILED runs on 2026-09-16 (durations 15 s, 2m02s, 5m00s) all read 'HTTP 502 before the SDK responded' on the self-hosted Inngest dashboard -- until then the whole tick was one step.run(sweep), i.e. one HTTP request carrying every seller in turn, each allowed up to INGEST_TIMEOUT_MS=170 s; the Railway edge cut the request. Now resolve-sellers is a step and each seller is a sweep-<id> step: one request per seller, finished sellers memoized, the trace names the seller a 502 landed on. Not verified: which seller each 502 hit, and whether the two short failures were a redeploy under the request. Test: 999-multibots-telegraf src/__tests__/services/crmProactive.sweepSteps.test.ts. 2026-10-07: LEGACY_ID, GUARD, SIDE_EFFECTS and the probe fields were corrected after gHashTag/trinity#1124 wrote its own reading of this function straight into the site mirror; each was checked against 999 main 40d0531eb. The code registers the id crm-proactive-sweep (crmProactiveSweep.ts#L103), the id the cron card inngest/999-multibots-telegraf/crm-proactive-sweep joins on. It returns on isSafeMode before its first step. The card goes to the seller's own private chat (services/crmProactive.ts pushCard), after the render's CRM tools are called over HTTP and a model turn is paid for; when the seller has turned autopilot on (999 #2903, #2925), pushCard confirms the draft through the render's POST /api/tg/proposal/confirm instead, and the message lands in the client's chat from the seller's account with no press, so messages-user stays. No safe probe was sent: the 2026-09-09 probe pass predates the registration.
fields.SUMMARY_EN: Every 30 minutes resolves the connected sellers (owner first) and runs one proactive CRM tick per seller, each in its own step, so a seller's stalled clients get a card in the seller's Telegram; one run at a time, no retries.

summary.en: Every 30 minutes resolves the connected sellers (owner first) and runs one proactive CRM tick per seller, each in its own step, so a seller's stalled clients get a card in the seller's Telegram; one run at a time, no retries.

fields.NAME: AI-server payment processing
fields.NOTE: The manifest carries no file, steps or retries for this function (its extractor did not resolve them); SERVICE, STEPS and RETRIES here were read from the same checkout, where retries is declared as 3 and onFailure is createInngestFailureHandler, which logs and messages the admin chat -- the manifest says on_failure log. Guard is amount-match: an amount matching no plan or option stops the run, which is why the 2026-09-09 probe with IncSum 0.01 COMPLETED without a balance change. 2026-09-17 (money loop, plan section 6 item 3): a claim-invoice step now sits between get-bot-config and update-user-balance (core/supabase/claimPendingInvoice.ts). The payments_v2 row must exist and its amount (parseFloat(OutSum), RUB) must equal the rounded IncSum, else NonRetriableError -- no credit, the onFailure handler messages the admin chat. The PENDING -> COMPLETED flip is a compare-and-set (.eq status PENDING, .select); a lost race or an already COMPLETED row returns {success:true, already_claimed:true} without crediting or notifying. A database error on the claim stays a plain Error so the 3 retries have it. Until then updateUserBalance set COMPLETED by inv_id unconditionally and returned true even when no row matched, and the event amount was never compared with the invoice. The Robokassa ResultURL route settles the same rows with the same compare-and-set, so between the two paths an invoice credits at most once. Not verified: the events for this function have no sender in the repo (orphan-events baseline); who sends them was not established. Test: 999-multibots-telegraf src/__tests__/money/paymentClaimInvoice.test.ts.

fields.NAME: Render job

Now sendCallback rethrows, the try/catch is gone: Inngest retries the step RETRIES times, then the run fails and onFailure messages the admin; the rendered file is already in S3 by then and its URL sits in the upload-to-s3 step output. create-job-folder: the plan asked for mkdir -p, but the render host is Windows (helpers/config.ts) and ssh.exec resolves on any exit code, so a re-run over an existing folder does not fail; left as is. Test: 999-multibots-telegraf src/__tests__/render/deliveryIsNotSwallowed.test.ts.

fields.NAME: Money: roubles that arrived and were never credited
